# Voice

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Voice`](gmeow-Voice.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Voice>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

A continuity strand binding MusicalSegments together; may host its own [`MusicalTimeFrame`](gmeow-MusicalTimeFrame.md), [`TuningSystem`](gmeow-TuningSystem.md), and [`MetricStructure`](gmeow-MetricStructure.md). The carrier for polymeter, tempo canons, aleatoric boxes, and per-voice tuning/time frames ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).
